exitCodes.meaning: The fetch completed; the payload lists the remotes fetched. One journal entry, operation fetch, written first: undo puts the remote-tracking refs back.
Invalid arguments — fetch takes at most one <remote>, and no flags.
The request failed for a reason the other codes do not name.
Not a repository; no remote of that name; or git fetch failed — an unreachable remote or a missing credential (terminal prompts are disabled).

summary: Fetch every remote (git fetch --all), or one. Never prompts for credentials.
